issue.title: Add action to be able to set the home
issue.body:
Hi! I would like to add an action to allow setting the current home using the _MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME (179)_ command.
See https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME

comments.body: Have you tried it with an autopilot? I didn't know this was implemented 🤔

I use it with ArduPilot to set the home before flying (ArduCopter https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/master/ArduCopter/mode_auto.cpp#L793 as well as ArduPlane https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/master/ArduPlane/commands_logic.cpp#L133).

issue.title: Action: add set_home

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Implements `set_home` action as requested in #2799.

## What it does

Adds `Action::set_home(use_current_location, latitude_deg, longitude_deg, absolute_altitude_m)` which sends `MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME` (179).

- Uses `CommandInt` (not `CommandLong`) for full int32 lat/lon precision, following the `do_orbit`/`goto_location` pattern
- When `use_current_location=true`, only param1=1 is sent (no coordinates needed)
- When `use_current_location=false`, lat/lon are encoded as int32 ×1e7

## Files changed

- **Generated** (from updated proto): `action.hpp`, `action.cpp`, `action_service_impl.hpp`, `action.pb.h/.cc`, `action.grpc.pb.h/.cc`
- **Handwritten**: `action_impl.hpp` (declaration), `action_impl.cpp` (implementation)

## Dependencies

Depends on MAVSDK-Proto PR mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto#397 (submodule updated to that commit).

Closes #2799

Allows setting the home position via MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME.

Closes: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/2799

issue.title: Action: add set_home

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Adds `set_home()` action to MAVSDK, allowing to set the home position using `MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME`.

The function accepts either the current location (with `use_current_location=true`) or explicit latitude/longitude/altitude coordinates.

Also updates generated files for all languages (C++, C, Python) to match current MAVSDK-Proto, including:
- Based on https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/pull/397.
- Updated geofence, mission_raw, mocap, telemetry, telemetry_server bindings to match current proto

Closes #2799
